rules.name: Botnet Recruiters
rules.text: In the Income beat, each Botnet with no player Ambassador on it puts 1 Agent on the city, research station or factory next to it holding the most Agents (else on its own site).

rules.name: Warmongering
rules.text: Each round, a military base with an adversary Troop on or next to it makes 1 extra Drone, even past its cap; at most 1 extra a base in each production, whatever makes it.

rules.name: War Takes Ground
rules.text: When a Drone destroys a factory, it also destroys a Node on that hex.

difficulty.text: When a threat executes uncountered, the adversary also gains 4 compute.

research.name: Weapons Program
research.text: When the research track reaches its threshold, spend it: Muster 2: each country, 2 Troops on its lowest-numbered factory (else city).

levels.name: Sleeper Cells
levels.rule: When an Agent lands on a city, it falls at 3 agents, not 5.

levels.name: War Footing
levels.flavor: Every unanswered strike feeds the war machine.
levels.rule: When a threat executes uncountered, the adversary also gains 4 compute.

levels.name: Arms Race
levels.flavor: The labs build weapons, not cures.
levels.rule: When Weapons Program fires, it musters 3, not 2.

events.name: Probing Strikes
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 1. Infiltrate: coastal cities. Grow: cities.

events.name: Factory Drive
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 1 or Industry 1. Infiltrate: factories. Each country: a neutral factory opens on its lowest-numbered free industrial zone.

events.name: Long Patrols
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 1 or Cyber 1. Infiltrate: research stations. Botnets spread (level 1+): each country, a Botnet onto its lowest-numbered site without one next to one of its Botnets (a country with none: its lowest-numbered research station). Grow: cities.

events.name: War Drums
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 1 or Diplomacy 1. Infiltrate: cities. Sway 1 toward Discord. Grow: cities.

events.name: Signal Jamming
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 1 or Power 1. Infiltrate: botnet hexes. Income: +1 compute a country a round. Botnets spread (level 1+): each country, a Botnet onto its lowest-numbered site without one next to one of its Botnets (a country with none: its lowest-numbered research station). Grow: research stations.

events.name: Mobilization
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 2. Infiltrate: coastal cities. Spill (level 2+): each city holding 2 or more Agents moves 1 onto the factory next to it holding the most. Grow: cities.

events.name: Station Raids
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 2 or Cyber 2. Infiltrate: research stations. Botnets spread (level 1+): each country, a Botnet onto its lowest-numbered site without one next to one of its Botnets (a country with none: its lowest-numbered research station). Spill (level 2+): each city holding 2 or more Agents moves 1 onto the research station next to it holding the most. Grow: research stations.

events.name: Shell Labs
events.text: Threat, each country: Cyber 2 or Industry 2. Infiltrate: research stations. Each country: a neutral research station opens on its lowest-numbered empty station site.

events.name: Fifth Column
events.text: Threat, each country: Diplomacy 2 or Cyber 2. Infiltrate: cities. Botnets spread (level 1+): each country, a Botnet onto its lowest-numbered site without one next to one of its Botnets (a country with none: its lowest-numbered research station). Spill (level 2+): each factory holding 2 or more Agents moves 1 onto the city next to it holding the most. Grow: cities.

events.name: Border War
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 2. Infiltrate: factories. Each player with a Node on or next to a front's base destroys 1 of those Nodes. Spill (level 2+): each city holding 2 or more Agents moves 1 onto the factory next to it holding the most. Grow: factories.

events.name: Supply Lines
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 1 or Industry 1, and Security 2 or Industry 2. Infiltrate: factories. Income: +1 compute a country a round. Spill (level 2+): each research station holding 2 or more Agents moves 1 onto the factory next to it holding the most. Grow: factories.

events.name: Forced March
events.text: Threat, each country: any tier-2 threat. Infiltrate: cities. Every adversary Troop takes 1 more step this round. Spill (level 2+): each research station holding 2 or more Agents moves 1 onto the city next to it holding the most. Grow: cities.

events.name: Total Mobilization
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 2, and Industry 2 or Power 2. Infiltrate: factories. Infiltrate: cities. Muster 1: each country, 1 Troop on its lowest-numbered factory (else city). Remove 2 Unity from the Unity track. Spill (level 2+): each city holding 2 or more Agents moves 1 onto the factory next to it holding the most. Grow: factories.

events.name: Blitzkrieg
events.text: Threat, each country: any tier-2 threat, and Security 2 or Diplomacy 2. Infiltrate: cities. Infiltrate: research stations. Muster 1: each country, 1 Troop on its lowest-numbered factory (else city). Sway 1 toward Discord. Each country: 1 Fallout lands next to its lowest-numbered corrupted city. Spill (level 2+): each research station holding 2 or more Agents moves 1 onto the city next to it holding the most.

events.name: Occupation
events.text: Threat, each country: Security 2 or Cyber 2, and Diplomacy 2. Infiltrate: research stations. Infiltrate: cities. Muster 1: each country, 1 Troop on its lowest-numbered factory (else city). Spill (level 2+): each city holding 2 or more Agents moves 1 onto the research station next to it holding the most. Grow: research stations.

events.name: Naval Blockade
events.text: Threat, each country: Industry 2 or Power 2, and Security 2 or Cyber 2. Infiltrate: coastal cities. Infiltrate: factories. Muster 1: each country, 1 Troop on its lowest-numbered factory (else city). Until the end of next round, cities make no energy and no Discord. Each country: 1 Fallout lands next to its lowest-numbered corrupted city. Spill (level 2+): each factory holding 2 or more Agents moves 1 onto the city next to it holding the most.
